units.rawText: Under the night sky, the flames of war continue burning.
units.displayText: Under the night sky, the flames of war continue burning.

spans.text: Under the night sky, the flames of war continue burning.

units.rawText: Did those people run this way!?
units.displayText: Did those people run this way!?

spans.text: Did those people run this way!?

units.rawText: I'm pretty sure one of them took one in the knee, so they couldn't have gone far. They've got to be nearby.
units.displayText: I'm pretty sure one of them took one in the knee, so they couldn't have gone far. They've got to be nearby.

spans.text: I'm pretty sure one of them took one in the knee, so they couldn't have gone far. They've got to be nearby.

units.rawText: Don't lose yourselves in the chase, our objective lies further behind them...
units.displayText: Don't lose yourselves in the chase, our objective lies further behind them...

spans.text: Don't lose yourselves in the chase, our objective lies further behind them...

units.rawText: After the enemy soldiers' voices fade into the distance, the ground suddenly trembles.
units.displayText: After the enemy soldiers' voices fade into the distance, the ground suddenly trembles.

spans.text: After the enemy soldiers' voices fade into the distance, the ground suddenly trembles.

units.rawText: Clotho lifts her coffin off of her, and gets up from the little hole she was hiding in.
units.displayText: Clotho lifts her coffin off of her, and gets up from the little hole she was hiding in.

spans.text: Clotho lifts her coffin off of her, and gets up from the little hole she was hiding in.

units.rawText: The medics should have made it back by now.
units.displayText: The medics should have made it back by now.

spans.text: The medics should have made it back by now.

units.rawText: Eh, I wouldn't be so quick to say that, but I get the feeling their luck is pretty good. Better than ours, at least.
units.displayText: Eh, I wouldn't be so quick to say that, but I get the feeling their luck is pretty good. Better than ours, at least.

spans.text: Eh, I wouldn't be so quick to say that, but I get the feeling their luck is pretty good. Better than ours, at least.

units.rawText: Well, we can't make jokes about how our room door's all busted up now, since I've got the feeling we're worse off than that door. Clotho, how are you holding up?
units.displayText: Well, we can't make jokes about how our room door's all busted up now, since I've got the feeling we're worse off than that door. Clotho, how are you holding up?

spans.text: Well, we can't make jokes about how our room door's all busted up now, since I've got the feeling we're worse off than that door. Clotho, how are you holding up?

units.rawText: I'm fine... We need to break out as soon as possible.
units.displayText: I'm fine... We need to break out as soon as possible.

spans.text: I'm fine... We need to break out as soon as possible.

units.rawText: Clotho tugs at the shreds of her sleeve and binds her deformed arm.
units.displayText: Clotho tugs at the shreds of her sleeve and binds her deformed arm.

spans.text: Clotho tugs at the shreds of her sleeve and binds her deformed arm.

units.rawText: Wait, are you seriously going to do this, Clotho, my mistress, my dear sister? You're going to stage a breakout before help has even arrived? Did your logic module get damaged or something?
units.displayText: Wait, are you seriously going to do this, Clotho, my mistress, my dear sister? You're going to stage a breakout before help has even arrived? Did your logic module get damaged or something?

spans.text: Wait, are you seriously going to do this, Clotho, my mistress, my dear sister? You're going to stage a breakout before help has even arrived? Did your logic module get damaged or something?

units.rawText: Nobody will come for us.
units.displayText: Nobody will come for us.

spans.text: Nobody will come for us.

units.rawText: I told you not to be so negative, but I guess you're right! Fine, so which way should we go?
units.displayText: I told you not to be so negative, but I guess you're right! Fine, so which way should we go?

spans.text: I told you not to be so negative, but I guess you're right! Fine, so which way should we go?

units.rawText: Judging by the first order the alert gave us... We should head toward the base.
units.displayText: Judging by the first order the alert gave us... We should head toward the base.

spans.text: Judging by the first order the alert gave us... We should head toward the base.

units.rawText: Clotho crawls out of her hole, looking towards the distance—
units.displayText: Clotho crawls out of her hole, looking towards the distance—

spans.text: Clotho crawls out of her hole, looking towards the distance—

units.rawText: Bang!
units.displayText: Bang!

spans.text: Bang!

units.rawText: And then she falls backward as a shot rings out.
units.displayText: And then she falls backward as a shot rings out.

spans.text: And then she falls backward as a shot rings out.

units.rawText: They found us... My shoulder's been hit. But how?
units.displayText: They found us... My shoulder's been hit. But how?

spans.text: They found us... My shoulder's been hit. But how?

units.rawText: Clotho... Master! Master, are you alright?
units.displayText: Clotho... Master! Master, are you alright?

spans.text: Clotho... Master! Master, are you alright?

units.rawText: I knew it, there was another one still here. Let me see... Why is it a Doll?
units.displayText: I knew it, there was another one still here. Let me see... Why is it a Doll?

spans.text: I knew it, there was another one still here. Let me see... Why is it a Doll?

units.rawText: Tsk, I thought I'd be able to score an enemy kill.
units.displayText: Tsk, I thought I'd be able to score an enemy kill.

spans.text: Tsk, I thought I'd be able to score an enemy kill.

units.rawText: I warn you, don't you dare lay a hand on Clotho! If you do anything to her, you'll have bad luck, three whole days' worth!
units.displayText: I warn you, don't you dare lay a hand on Clotho! If you do anything to her, you'll have bad luck, three whole days' worth!

spans.text: I warn you, don't you dare lay a hand on Clotho! If you do anything to her, you'll have bad luck, three whole days' worth!

units.rawText: What the hell's making that racket? Is that a coffin?
units.displayText: What the hell's making that racket? Is that a coffin?

spans.text: What the hell's making that racket? Is that a coffin?

units.rawText: The enemy soldier takes aim at Clotho's head and Clotho closes her eyes. A familiar yet unfamiliar voice speaks into her ear.
units.displayText: The enemy soldier takes aim at Clotho's head and Clotho closes her eyes. A familiar yet unfamiliar voice speaks into her ear.

spans.text: The enemy soldier takes aim at Clotho's head and Clotho closes her eyes. A familiar yet unfamiliar voice speaks into her ear.

units.rawText: Clotho...
units.displayText: Clotho...

spans.text: Clotho...

units.rawText: (Atropos, Lachesis...)
units.displayText: Atropos, Lachesis...

spans.text: Atropos, Lachesis...

units.rawText: Clotho, I'm sorry. Bearing the weight of the deceased is too much for the living.
units.displayText: Clotho, I'm sorry. Bearing the weight of the deceased is too much for the living.

spans.text: Clotho, I'm sorry. Bearing the weight of the deceased is too much for the living.

units.rawText: We will be following those other souls to the afterlife now.
units.displayText: We will be following those other souls to the afterlife now.

spans.text: We will be following those other souls to the afterlife now.

units.rawText: (...That's alright. I understand. Since my final destination has been decided, I should start on my journey as soon as possible.)
units.displayText: ...That's alright. I understand. Since my final destination has been decided, I should start on my journey as soon as possible.

spans.text: ...That's alright. I understand. Since my final destination has been decided, I should start on my journey as soon as possible.

units.rawText: (I'm coming to meet you now...)
units.displayText: I'm coming to meet you now...

spans.text: I'm coming to meet you now...

units.rawText: Clotho.
units.displayText: Clotho.

spans.text: Clotho.

units.rawText: Clotho, your wounds have only just recovered. Please take care of yourself.
units.displayText: Clotho, your wounds have only just recovered. Please take care of yourself.

spans.text: Clotho, your wounds have only just recovered. Please take care of yourself.

units.rawText: Yes, I will.
units.displayText: Yes, I will.

spans.text: Yes, I will.

units.rawText: (Why am I remembering this now?)
units.displayText: Why am I remembering this now?

spans.text: Why am I remembering this now?

units.rawText: Will there be tea when I come back?
units.displayText: Will there be tea when I come back?

spans.text: Will there be tea when I come back?

units.rawText: Of course. And if you don't have too many wounds, there'll be scones too.
units.displayText: Of course. And if you don't have too many wounds, there'll be scones too.

spans.text: Of course. And if you don't have too many wounds, there'll be scones too.

units.rawText: I'll prepare them and wait for you to come back.
units.displayText: I'll prepare them and wait for you to come back.

spans.text: I'll prepare them and wait for you to come back.

units.rawText: Clotho's eyes snap open and at almost the same time, a ray of brilliant light illuminates the darkened rubble.
units.displayText: Clotho's eyes snap open and at almost the same time, a ray of brilliant light illuminates the darkened rubble.

spans.text: Clotho's eyes snap open and at almost the same time, a ray of brilliant light illuminates the darkened rubble.

units.rawText: Hands up! You're surrounded!
units.displayText: Hands up! You're surrounded!

spans.text: Hands up! You're surrounded!

units.rawText: Bloody hell, when did they flank us from behind!?
units.displayText: Bloody hell, when did they flank us from behind!?

spans.text: Bloody hell, when did they flank us from behind!?

units.rawText: Ignore them, they must be bluffing!
units.displayText: Ignore them, they must be bluffing!

spans.text: Ignore them, they must be bluffing!

units.rawText: But there's something funny about those voices! Fall back!
units.displayText: But there's something funny about those voices! Fall back!

spans.text: But there's something funny about those voices! Fall back!

units.rawText: Oh no, we're too late...
units.displayText: Oh no, we're too late...

spans.text: Oh no, we're too late...

units.rawText: The rapid gunshots come and go in an instant. Clotho looks up towards the source.
units.displayText: The rapid gunshots come and go in an instant. Clotho looks up towards the source.

spans.text: The rapid gunshots come and go in an instant. Clotho looks up towards the source.

units.rawText: Centaureissi's face appears above her.
units.displayText: Centaureissi's face appears above her.

spans.text: Centaureissi's face appears above her.

units.rawText: Don't move. Your spine's been damaged.
units.displayText: Don't move. Your spine's been damaged.

spans.text: Don't move. Your spine's been damaged.

units.rawText: Why did you come...
units.displayText: Why did you come...

spans.text: Why did you come...

units.rawText: Miss Mary gave us the coordinates, and we came to collect you.
units.displayText: Miss Mary gave us the coordinates, and we came to collect you.

spans.text: Miss Mary gave us the coordinates, and we came to collect you.

units.rawText: ...I see.
units.displayText: ...I see.

spans.text: ...I see.

units.rawText: Are... they safe?
units.displayText: Are... they safe?

spans.text: Are... they safe?

units.rawText: This time, the number of bodies didn't go up.
units.displayText: This time, the number of bodies didn't go up.

spans.text: This time, the number of bodies didn't go up.

units.rawText: Iron Maid, what are you doing?
units.displayText: Iron Maid, what are you doing?

spans.text: Iron Maid, what are you doing?

units.rawText: ...Tsk, I was wondering who it was, but turns out it was the Iron Crow.
units.displayText: ...Tsk, I was wondering who it was, but turns out it was the Iron Crow.

spans.text: ...Tsk, I was wondering who it was, but turns out it was the Iron Crow.

units.rawText: Mary said she saved them.
units.displayText: Mary said she saved them.

spans.text: Mary said she saved them.

units.rawText: It's her job!
units.displayText: It's her job!

spans.text: It's her job!

units.rawText: The soldiers say so in a nasty tone as they move up to grab Clotho by the arm.
units.displayText: The soldiers say so in a nasty tone as they move up to grab Clotho by the arm.

spans.text: The soldiers say so in a nasty tone as they move up to grab Clotho by the arm.

units.rawText: Iron Maid, you carry the coffin. I'll bring her back for repairs.
units.displayText: Iron Maid, you carry the coffin. I'll bring her back for repairs.

spans.text: Iron Maid, you carry the coffin. I'll bring her back for repairs.

units.rawText: Thank you.
units.displayText: Thank you.

spans.text: Thank you.

units.rawText: The group returns to the base. As she wobbles along, Clotho quietly admires the starry sky.
units.displayText: The group returns to the base. As she wobbles along, Clotho quietly admires the starry sky.

spans.text: The group returns to the base. As she wobbles along, Clotho quietly admires the starry sky.

units.rawText: (Is this not... my destined end?)
units.displayText: Is this not... my destined end?

spans.text: Is this not... my destined end?
